proof_summary: Introduce the auxiliary sequence \(b_0=2, b_1=56\) with \(b_{n+2}=-4b_{n+1}-64b_n\); its squares satisfy the same third-order recurrence as the odd-indexed subsequence of \(a\), obtained by eliminating the even/odd mixing from the original recurrence. Since the first three corresponding terms agree, induction over a three-term window gives \(a_{2n+1}=b_n^2\) for every \(n\).
